name: 0.14.9 Release
body:
A small update with a new feature (an option to show zeroed total network usage on startup) and some bug fixes.

---

## Bug Fixes

- [#2207](https://github.com/ClementTsang/bottom/pull/2207): Fix typo in `--help` flag (thanks @Oseryx!)
- [#2210](https://github.com/ClementTsang/bottom/pull/2210): Fix handling Linux cmdline values that don't have null byte separators (thanks @fxzzi!)

## Features

- [#2199](https://github.com/ClementTsang/bottom/pull/2199): Add option to show zeroed total network usage on startup

## New Contributors
* @Oseryx made their first contribution in https://github.com/ClementTsang/bottom/pull/2207
* @fxzzi made their first contribution in https://github.com/ClementTsang/bottom/pull/2210

---

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ClementTsang/bottom/compare/0.14.8...0.14.9
